subject: Ariba invite acceptance failing at CAPTCHA step — Holtren onboarding
messages:
From: Lena Torres <lena.torres@holtren-supplies.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble accepting Ariba invite — keeps looping on CAPTCHA

Hi Vanessa,

We received the Ariba supplier invite this morning (thank you) but every time someone on our procurement team clicks Accept they get a CAPTCHA screen that won't mark as complete. We tried Chrome and Edge, incognito, and a different network — same behavior. Screenshot attached.

We need to confirm vendor setup so PO routing can be completed. Can your team confirm whether there's any special header or cookie we should be preserving, or if there's an IP allowlist on your Ariba tenant? This is blocking our ability to acknowledge the SOW.

Thanks,
Lena Torres
Senior Sourcing Manager
Holtren Supplies

Attachment: screenshot-captcha-error.png
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.example
To: Lena Torres <lena.torres@holtren-supplies.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.example, marissa.cole@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting Ariba invite — keeps looping on CAPTCHA

Hi Lena —

I’m sorry you hit this. We don’t intentionally block CAPTCHAs; Ariba sometimes presents additional bot challenges when a redirector or unusual referrer is detected. I’ve copied Ben (SRE) and Marissa (onboarding) to triage. Could you confirm:

- The invite link you used (copy/paste the full URL if possible)
- Does the CAPTCHA show any domain (e.g., recaptcha.net) or an Ariba-branded challenge?
- If you can, please try opening the invite on a mobile network (personal hotspot) as a quick test and report results.

We’ll escalate on our side if it looks like the Ariba tenant is misdetecting traffic.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Success — Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachment referenced: ariba-invite-headers.txt
From: ben.carter@redwood.example
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.example, marissa.cole@redwood.example
Cc: Lena Torres <lena.torres@holtren-supplies.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting Ariba invite — keeps looping on CAPTCHA

Adding what I can from the infra side. I pulled the invite URL from the headers Van used and proxied it through a test box. Observations:

- The Ariba tenant served a reCAPTCHA v2 widget (3p recaptcha endpoint) that expects a valid referrer and cookie flow.
- Our logs show the redirect chain includes an intermediate CDN redirect that strips the Referer header in certain client configurations — that can trigger reCAPTCHA to present the challenge repeatedly.
- There is no IP allowlist on our Ariba tenant for Holtren specifically.

Workarounds we can try now: 
1) Provide them a one-time direct invite token (bypass the redirecting invite page) — short-lived, single-use.
2) Ask Holtren to try from a network that preserves Referer (some corporate proxies remove Referer by policy).
3) Request Ariba support to relax bot heuristics for the invite flow (this will take 24–48 hours).

I can generate a one-time token if Vanessa approves. If we go that route, Marissa: can you confirm we can sign the invite token into the existing Ariba action without creating a duplicate vendor profile?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Platform SRE — Redwood Inference

- We tried from a personal hotspot and it still presented the same loop. Our security team uses an outbound proxy that likely strips Referer.

If you can provide the one-time token, that would be ideal — please ensure it links to the existing vendor name (Holtren Supplies) and doesn’t create a second vendor record. We’ll take the token and confirm acceptance.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
